measurements.name: numberOfDaysInStatus
measurements.description: Number of days an agent has been in a particular status in the selected time range. In case, an agent sets up status as Break multiple times in a day, it will be considered as one. Example: To find out the number of days on which an agent was in Available status in the last 30 Days, use this metric, with the filter of Agent Status as Available and date range as Last 30 Days.

measurements.name: TIME_SPENT_IN_STATUS
measurements.description: Time Spent in the status in given Interval, to be used with Agent Status

measurements.name: agentCount
measurements.description: Number of agents that has been in a particular status in the selected time range. Note: This metric shouldn't be used to get hourly trend of available or logged in agent, as it works on Status Assign Time (Default), which means if user doesn't change status from 10am - 2PM, then in hourly trend we will only get one count against 10 am interval, since status was assigned in that interval.

measurements.name: DOC_COUNT
measurements.description: Number of times an agent has been in a particular status in the selected time range.

measurements.script: def rv = 0.0d; if(doc.containsKey('uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating') &&doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value!= null&&doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value.length()>=1){rv = Double.parseDouble(doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value);} boolean filterMode = false; if(params.get('filterMode') != null) { filterMode = params.get('filterMode'); }if(filterMode) {String filterType = 'EQUALS'; if(params.get('filterType') != null) { filterType = params.get('filterType');} def values = params.get('filterValues'); if(values == null || values.size() < 1) { return false;} String filterValue = String.valueOf(values.get(0)); double cmpVal = Double.parseDouble(filterValue); if('GTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>=cmpVal;} else if('GT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>cmpVal;} else if('LTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<=cmpVal;} else if('LT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<cmpVal;} else if('EQUALS'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv==cmpVal;} else {return false;}} else { return rv;}

measurements.script: def rv = 0.0d; double initial_csat = 0; double predicted_csat = 0; if(doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_initial_csat_rating'].value == null ||doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value == null) { rv = 0.0;} else{ initial_csat = Double.parseDouble(doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_initial_csat_rating'].value); predicted_csat = Double.parseDouble(doc['uCW.cProp.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value); rv = predicted_csat - initial_csat;} boolean filterMode = false; if(params.get('filterMode') != null) { filterMode = params.get('filterMode'); }if(filterMode) {String filterType = 'EQUALS'; if(params.get('filterType') != null) { filterType = params.get('filterType');} def values = params.get('filterValues'); if(values == null || values.size() < 1) { return false;} String filterValue = String.valueOf(values.get(0)); double cmpVal = Double.parseDouble(filterValue); if('GTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>=cmpVal;} else if('GT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>cmpVal;} else if('LTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<=cmpVal;} else if('LT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<cmpVal;} else if('EQUALS'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv==cmpVal;} else {return false;}} else { return rv;}

measurements.script: def rv = 0.0d; if(doc.containsKey('caseCustomProperties.mappedCustomProperties.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating') &&doc['caseCustomProperties.mappedCustomProperties.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value!= null&&doc['caseCustomProperties.mappedCustomProperties.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value.length()>=1){rv = Double.parseDouble(doc['caseCustomProperties.mappedCustomProperties.spr_uc_predicted_csat_rating'].value);} boolean filterMode = false; if(params.get('filterMode') != null) { filterMode = params.get('filterMode'); }if(filterMode) {String filterType = 'EQUALS'; if(params.get('filterType') != null) { filterType = params.get('filterType');} def values = params.get('filterValues'); if(values == null || values.size() < 1) { return false;} String filterValue = String.valueOf(values.get(0)); double cmpVal = Double.parseDouble(filterValue); if('GTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>=cmpVal;} else if('GT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv>cmpVal;} else if('LTE'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<=cmpVal;} else if('LT'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv<cmpVal;} else if('EQUALS'.compareTo(filterType) == 0) {return rv==cmpVal;} else {return false;}} else { return rv;}

measurements.description: The total duration for which cases were assigned to an agent. For example, if 4 cases were concurrently assigned to an agent from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM, the throughput would be 120 minutes (30 minutes per assignment ï¿½ 4 cases).

values: พร้อมใช้งาน

measurements.description: The time spent in the agent statuses where case was assigned to them in the specified period - ready status will be based on sum of agent status as configured in the "Standard Metrics Screen"

values: พร้อมใช้งาน

measurements.description: The time spent in any status other than Offline and Ready for the specified period. It is dependant on Ready Time metric and is calculated as Logged In Time - Ready Time

measurements.description: The percentage of time that an agent actively spent handling the cases. It is calculated as Time Spent in Ready Status with any case assigned / Ready Time

measurements.name: NOT_READY_STATUS_PERCENTAGE

measurements.name: CASE_OCCUPIED_TIME

values: พร้อมใช้งาน

measurements.name: READY_STATUS_PERCENTAGE
measurements.description: The percentage of time that an agent was available to work/ handle cases actively. It is calculated as Ready Time/ Logged In Time and hence dependant on statuses configured in Ready Time metric

measurements.name: AGENT_IDLE_TIME_NOT_WORKING
measurements.description: Time for which agent was in ready status but did't had any case opened on care console or third pane irrespective of the cases assigned to them

measurements.name: CONTACT_AVG_HANDLE_TIME
measurements.description: Avg handle time for all contacts which are assigned to the agent for digital cases whereas answered by the agent for voice cases.

measurements.name: TOTAL_CONTACTS_OFFERED
measurements.description: Contacts offered to the work queue i.e the contact that entered any work queue. A contact is every case/call that comes into queue - even if transferred. Every new offer to queue is counted as new contact offered. In case of transfer to same queue, it will be counted as 2.

measurements.name: CONTACT_AVG_SPEED_OF_ANS
measurements.description: Avg speed of answer for all contacts which are answered within the work queue i.e speed of answer averaged over total contacts answered in the work queue.

measurements.name: CONTACTS_TRANSFERRED_COUNT
measurements.description: Count of contacts which are transferred to another work-queue or agent after agent assignment

measurements.name: DIGITAL_AVG_AGENT_RESPONSE_TIME
measurements.description: Avg response time by the agent on the contact in the work queue over total contacts answered.

measurements.name: TOTAL_CONTACTS_ABANDONED
measurements.description: Contacts which are abandoned in the work queue before the agent is assigned on the case. In case of voice - customer abandoned the call. In case of livechat - customer closed the chat/inactivity before the agent assignment.

measurements.name: CONTACT_HANDLE_TIME
measurements.description: Duration that a contact is assigned to the agent in the work queue. For digital - this is based on assigned duration. For voice - this is based on talk time, hold time, wrap time etc based on the config selected in the Standard Metrics screen.

measurements.name: CONTACT_SPEED_OF_ANS
measurements.description: Time taken for a contact to be answered by the agent in the work queue. It captures time from work queue entry time till the contact is answered. This is only captured for contacts answered.

measurements.name: TOTAL_CONTACTS_ANSWERED
measurements.description: Contacts which are assigned to agent and further replied/answered by agents. In case of voice - answered is calculated when the agent answers the call, and in case of digital - if the agent makes the first reply on the case post entering the work queue.

measurements.name: TOTAL_SYSTEM_REMOVED_CONTACTS
measurements.description: Count of contacts for system-driven closures after queue wait

measurements.name: DIGITAL_AGENT_RESPONSE_TIME
measurements.description: Overall time taken by the agent to make a response on the contact which captures all the to and fro customer/agent messages on the contact. Calculated for all contacts that entered the queue, applicable for digital channels only.

measurements.name: CONTACT_ANS_TIMESTAMP
measurements.description: Timestamp when the contact was answered by the agent i.e first response time in cases of digital, and agent answer in cases of voice.

measurements.name: PERCENT_CONTACTS_ABANDONED
measurements.description: Percentage of contacts which were abandoned in the work queue i.e Contacts Abandoned / Contacts Offered.

measurements.name: CONTACTS_FLEW_OUT_COUNT
measurements.description: Contacts re-routed to another work queue without getting assigned to the agent or abandoned by the customer post entering the work queue. It can be due to routing config or cancelled warm transfers.

measurements.name: CONTACT_QUEUE_TIME
measurements.description: Duration that a contact spends in the work queue right from the time contact enters the work queue until the contact is either assigned to the agent or the contact is abandoned.

measurements.name: TOTAL_CONTACTS_ASSIGNED
measurements.description: Contacts which are assigned to the agent post entering the work queue. Assignment is calculated for each contact offered to the work queue. This is only calculated for digital channels.

measurements.name: CaseProcessingSLA
measurements.description: Duration that a contact is handled in the work queue based on case processing clock on the case i.e duration that the agent is actively working on the case. This will be only calculated for cases opened by the assigned agents

measurements.name: CONTACT_AVG_PROCESSING_TIME
measurements.description: Avg handle time for all contacts which are handled in work queue based on case processing clock on the case i.e Handle Time (Case Clock)/ Contacts Assigned

measurements.name: CONTACTS_ASSIGNED_WITHIN_SLA
measurements.description: Contacts which are assigned to the agents within the defined SLA threshold. The threshold is defined at the work queue level, and can be set  in "Queue Standard Metrics" screen under the section Service Level Agreement.. The threshold is based on time to assign

measurements.name: CONTACTS_ASSIGNED_WITHIN_SLA_PERCENT
measurements.description: This metric calculates for service level based on contacts assigned. % of contacts assigned to the agents within the defined SLA threshold over contacts offered to the work queue. The threshold is defined at the work queue level, and can be set in "Queue Standard Metrics" screen

measurements.name: CONTACTS_ANSWERED_WITHIN_SLA
measurements.description: Contacts which are answered by agents post assignment within the defined SLA threshold. The threshold is defined at the work queue level, and can be set  in "Queue Standard Metrics" screen under the section Service Level Agreement. The threshold is based on speed of answer

measurements.name: CONTACTS_ANS_WITHIN_SLA_PERCENT
measurements.description: Service Level calculates the % of contacts which were answered within the defined threshold over total contacts offered to the work queue.The threshold is defined at the work queue level, and can be set in "Queue Standard Metrics " screen

measurements.name: CONTACTS_SHORT_ABANDONED_COUNT
measurements.description: Contacts which are abandoned in the work queue within a defined threshold. The threshold is defined at the work queue level, and can be set  in "Queue Standard Metrics" screen under the short abandon section. This is applicable only for live chat channel only for Digital

measurements.name: UNIQUE_CASES
measurements.description: Unique Case Macro Usage Count refers to the distinct number of cases on which a macro has been applied. Note: that this uniqueness is determined through aggregation within the widget. For example, if three different macros were applied to a single case (such as "Assign to X," "Escalated," and "Closed" at different times), the Unique Case Macro Usage Count, when aggregated by the "Macro name," would display three entries. However, the total count will show as one, reflecting the unique cases where macros were applied.
